text: A long time ago, musicians figured out harmonic tones just by ear. One day a mathematician in the 6th century named Pythagoras was walking by a blacksmith shop when he heard the different size hammers pounding on the anvil simultaneously. Some of them were producing harmonic tones. He ran inside the blacksmith shop and noticed that the hammers were all different sizes. He started playing with the hammers two at a time and saw that they were producing harmonic tones. He had a big aha moment. It's the ratio of the hammers that was producing different tones. So he applied this to writing music and came up with the diatonic scale that we know as doramifasolotito. Pythagoras believed that the planets themselves all had heavenly bodies and they rang out notes of vibration based on their orbit and their distance to each other. There are seven notes in the scale just like there's seven days of the week and there are 12 total notes between C and C or any octave just like there's 12 months in the year. Beautiful music is the harmonic energy that sings throughout the universe. I believe that music is so powerful it can heal the world. In fact that's my mission statement to heal the world with music. The word universe means one song. We've all felt the vibration of beautiful music and what it can do to our soul. I'm going to teach you how to put harmonies together so that you can play the piano and create beautiful harmonic music that will go out into the entire universe forever. So let's get started.
